# Bart Jaworski - Personal Website

> Hello Agent! This is the personal website of Bart Jaworski, focused on AI safety, technology, and books.

## About

Bart Jaworski is a technologist and writer focused on ensuring AGI development goes well and safely. He believes we are living in the most important century of humanity. He reads approximately one book per week and writes about AI safety, technology, and books.

## Site Structure

- Homepage: https://bartjaworski.com/ (single-page site with links)

## Writing

All writing (essays, annual book reviews, and other posts) has moved to Substack: https://substack.com/@84rt
